name: Rainforest Alliance
mission: The Rainforest Alliance works to encourage better on-the-ground forestry practices by rewarding businesses, communities and governments that meet standards for sustainability.
theoryOfChange: The Rainforest Alliance has a published Theory of Change, which describes the intended sustainability outcomes and impacts of their standard and the strategies that contribute to these outcomes (causal pathways). This framework presents a results chain logic for their 2020 certification program, outlining outputs, short-term outcomes, intermediate outcomes, long-term outcomes, and impacts. It is used for internal monitoring and evaluation (M&E) of the certification program and to communicate program impacts to external stakeholders. The Theory of Change also reflects their 'Reimagining Certification approach,' emphasizing continuous improvement, contextualization of requirements, shared responsibility, and a due diligence approach to human rights issues.
